introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics Paper 2 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2020. Duration: three hours.**

Answer ALL 10 questions. For your guidance, the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated. Mathematical formulae and tables published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

questions.enonce_markdown: Solve in $\mathbb{N}$, the system of equations $$3x \equiv 1 \pmod 5, \qquad 5x \equiv 2 \pmod 7.$$
questions.corrige_markdown:
**First congruence.** $3\cdot 2 = 6 \equiv 1 \pmod 5$, so $2$ is the inverse of $3$ modulo $5$. Multiplying $3x \equiv 1$ by $2$:
$$x \equiv 2 \pmod 5.$$
**Second congruence.** $5\cdot 3 = 15 \equiv 1 \pmod 7$, so $3$ is the inverse of $5$ modulo $7$. Multiplying $5x \equiv 2$ by $3$:
$$x \equiv 6 \pmod 7.$$
**Combining (Chinese remainder theorem; $5$ and $7$ are coprime).** Write $x = 6 + 7k$ from the second congruence and substitute in the first:
$$6 + 7k \equiv 2 \pmod 5 \ \Longrightarrow\ 1 + 2k \equiv 2 \ \Longrightarrow\ 2k \equiv 1 \ \Longrightarrow\ k \equiv 3 \pmod 5$$
(multiply by $3$, the inverse of $2$ modulo $5$). So $k = 3 + 5m$ and $x = 6 + 7(3 + 5m) = 27 + 35m$.

$$\boxed{x \equiv 27 \pmod{35}, \ \text{ that is } x = 27 + 35m,\ m \in \mathbb{N}\ (27,\ 62,\ 97,\ \dots)}$$

**Check.** $x = 27$: $3\cdot 27 = 81 = 16\cdot 5 + 1 \equiv 1 \pmod 5$ and $5\cdot 27 = 135 = 19\cdot 7 + 2 \equiv 2 \pmod 7$.
